subject: world_language
concept: Understanding the main points of a moderately longer text or spoken passage on a familiar topic
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR B1 'understand main points of clear standard input' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student follows along with pictures while hearing/reading a longer target-language passage
exercise.abstract: Student summarizes the main point of the passage, not just isolated details

misconception_flags: can recall isolated details but cannot identify the passage's overall main point

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
